metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them pizza and somehow got 3 kills? Valorant logic is on fire!
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like I was smashing a bug frenzy style.
Enemy probably thinking about uninstalling.
Pretending this was skill for a hot 0.15 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a mess but kills still rain in!

Tap if your aim's a disaster but the game still says YES!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
